biotools.summary: MAYA is an open-source tool that automatically constructs a chemical multiverse and generates multiple visualizations of chemical spaces to explore structure-multiple activity relationships. The tool uses various structural descriptors and data visualization techniques and is available on GitHub with comprehensive documentation.
biotools.name: MAYA (Multiple Activity Analyzer)
